findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_auto_insurance_quote, get_home_insurance_quote, get_bundle_insurance_quote · Private data: get_auto_insurance_quote, get_home_insurance_quote, get_bundle_insurance_quote · Public sink: get_auto_insurance_quote, get_home_insurance_quote, get_bundle_insurance_quote · Destructive: get_auto_insurance_quote, get_home_insurance_quote, get_bundle_insurance_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_auto_insurance_quote, get_home_insurance_quote, get_bundle_insurance_quote · Private data: get_auto_insurance_quote, get_home_insurance_quote, get_bundle_insurance_quote · Public sink: get_auto_insurance_quote, get_home_insurance_quote, get_bundle_insurance_quote · Destructive: get_auto_insurance_quote, get_home_insurance_quote, get_bundle_insurance_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "get_auto_insurance_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
